eligible_family_rule: Step 2.2 family has at least one pore descriptor with within-family fractional span >= 10%
pair_difference: abs(x_i - x_j) / max(abs(x_i), abs(x_j)); zero when both are zero
pair_score: maximum fractional difference across the eight pore descriptors
tie_break_1: larger mean fractional difference across the eight pore descriptors
tie_break_2: lexicographically smallest sorted pair of mof_id values
